title: Sodium/potassium poly(heptazine imide) with an electron sink effect for hydrogen peroxide photosynthesis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6202-6213
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00652J, Paper
Xiao Fang, Bonan Li, Jiao Huang, Chunlian Hu, Xu Yang, Pengfei Feng, Xiaoyu Dong, Junhao Wu, Yuanyuan Li, Yong Ding
Sodium/potassium poly(heptazine imide) (NaK-PHI) with an electron sink effect is synthesized in ternary eutectic salts to improve charge separation and transport efficiency for H2O2 production.
